# Vendored WowType core

Copied from Gloridust/WowType `core/` at commit `38eb269989a4c54c96c4b5749a13294750498b5e`.
The upstream package declares `MIT OR Apache-2.0`; this vendored source is distributed under either license. License texts: https://opensource.org/license/mit and https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

The Android package manifest intentionally omits the optional desktop voice crate and exposes only the static C ABI library. Keep upstream source changes isolated and document local patches here.
